description.en: DSH conversation deletion with an optional, previewed cascade into conversation-associated memory: soft delete + recycle bin, audit trail, batch rate limits and per-session rollback. 删除对话（可选一并删除关联记忆）：软删除与回收站、审计留痕、批量限流、失败回滚。

description.en: 对话树 / Conversation Tree：把对话按工作区与主题组织成一棵可折叠的树，并在会话列旁直接打开真实会话。
description.zh: 把对话按工作区与主题组织成一棵可折叠的树，并在会话列旁直接打开真实会话。

description.en: Use your own OpenAI-compatible vision model in DeepSeek Harness: images are described before the main model sees the request, plus an image_understand tool for reading charts, screenshots, UI and OCR.

description.en: A video workspace background with translucent composer surfaces for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 在侧边栏为已归档会话增加删除入口，并提供 delete_archived_conversation 工具供助手调用。
